Digital Foundation

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1674053212573{background-color: #ffffff !important;}”][vc_column width=”3/4″][vc_column_text css_animation=”zoomIn”]The Digital Foundation, officially presented on 5 May 2024 on the occasion of Holy Orthodox Easter, consists of 144,000 digital identities, i.e. tokens made available to all citizens of Sabourg and new digital residents of Sabourg who wish to participate in the digitalisation of the abbey state by donating a sum of money that will be used for economic development in order to realise the major projects of the Principality of Sabourg.

The Digital Foundation envisages the creation of a cryptocurrency that will be made available to all the micro-states of the international community that adhere to the project strongly desired by His Most Reverend Highness the Prince-Abate Archbishop of Sabourg, namely the creation of a new legal entity for international cooperation called: Organisation of the United Miscristates (OMU).[/vc_column_text][vc_video link=”https://youtu.be/8Z8EgNJ7It4″][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/4″][/vc_column][/vc_row]
